chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 435: Li Huowang Tortures the Truth Out of a Zuowandao
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finally has a Zuowandao Heart-Element trapped, but getting a straight answer is harder than pulling teeth. The interrogation turns brutal, and a shocking truth about the very nature of the Siming is revealed. He must find Zhuge Yuan.
og_title: A Brutal Interrogation and a Burning Golden Tree
og_description: Trapped in his own body, Li Huowang is the torturer, but the Zuowandao's Bei Feng still holds all the cards. His words about a Siming that controls both truth and falsehood threaten to shatter everything Li Huowang believes.
twitter_description: Li Huowang is torturing a Zuowandao for answers, but every scream feels like a lie. He needs to find Zhuge Yuan before it's too late. The golden tree is burning! #DaoGuiYiXian

lore_anchors.definition: A rare human constitution that blurs the line between reality and fiction; more an ontological curse than a source of power.
A Siming claimed to control the primordial essences of both Yin and Yang, and thus both truth and falsehood.
Rival empires in the Dao-Twisted World locked in a conflict that involves their highest authorities and supernatural battles.
The fundamental yin and yang forces in Chinese cosmology, here presented as domains controlled by a single, terrifying deity.
